responses: Machine learning is a way of getting computers to learn patterns from data instead of following hand-written rules. Examples: spam filters, recommendations and, here, intent classification.

patterns: how is deep learning different from machine learning
what is a deep learning model
responses: Deep learning is machine learning with many-layered neural networks that learn features automatically from raw data, which is what powers modern vision, speech and language systems.

patterns: what is speech and language processing

patterns: will AI take over the world
